metadata.title: Machine learning evidence from PISA 2018 data to integrate global competence intervention in UAE K–12 public schools

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used multiple plausible values and applied Rubin's rules for combining them.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Recorded evidence does not explicitly establish an unweighted analysis. Original extraction rationale: The study explicitly states that it uses publicly available PISA microdata without mentioning the application of sampling weights.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study models individual students without using multilevel modeling or accounting for school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation methods and only discusses internal validation strategies.
